proposed_sequence: Apply measured glue coverage to mating faces
Position panels and clamp with the fixture
Drive nails using a specified tool with physical access to each joint
Maintain support for the selected adhesive's handling interval
Check handling stability, then cured joint performance under specified loads
model_requirements: Nail engagement must follow a modelled driving operation, not target-pose proximity
Glue bonds require modelled application and mating-face contact within calibrated gap limits
Represent finite joint stiffness and failure instead of unconditional rigid welds
Keep glue age separate from simulator integration time if accelerated curing is used, and report that approximation
Calibrate on physical joints and validate on held-out joints and loads
scope: one front-left joint in optional FasteningBoxAssembly
